cards.prose: Matthew has Yahusha (Jesus) sending the twelve to *the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)*, and Luke has him say at Zacchaeus's table that the Son of Adam came *to seek and to save that which was lost*. They are the same lost ones, now sought by the one who sent the twelve out. The man at the table, a publican, is a son of Abraham by Luke's own word, one of the house.
cards.member_sentence: Matthew names the lost as the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), which tells who the Son of Adam came to seek.
